en: First ports reach the open world, still dark
VIctory and XCL forks load the world at under 2 fps. A 3 fps clip of a lit scene is unconfirmed.
zh: 首批移植进入开放世界，画面仍是黑的
VIctory 和 XCL 分支能加载世界，帧数不到 2。一段 3 帧的亮场景片段尚未证实。

en: Leonida, the biggest port project, goes offline
Repository, mirror and Discord vanished within an hour. The founder says Rockstar had the Discord removed; no DMCA notice is public.
zh: 最大的移植项目 Leonida 下线
仓库、镜像和 Discord 一小时内全部消失。创始人称 Discord 是 Rockstar 申请删的，但没有公开的 DMCA 记录。

en: Cyberleek releases the missing EXE
Outlets describe a ZIP of about 57 MB. Reports said a port reached a settings screen within three hours; that boot has not been independently verified.
zh: 大葱哥（Cyberleek）放出缺失的 EXE
媒体描述为一个约 57 MB 的 ZIP。有报道称 3 小时内有移植项目进到设置界面，这次启动未经独立核验。

en: First console patch, 1.002.002
Reported by heise. The leaked build (1.0.2.1) is now out of date.
zh: 主机版首个补丁 1.002.002
heise 报道。泄露版本（1.0.2.1）已经过时。

en: Cyberleek cuts its meme-coin target
The EXE was promised at a $15M market cap, cut to $6M. Neither was reached.
zh: 大葱哥下调迷因币目标
原定币市值到 1500 万美元就放 EXE，后降到 600 万，都没达到。

en: GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
No PC version. Rockstar says the game plays best on PS5.
zh: GTA 6 登陆 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S
没有 PC 版。Rockstar 称 PS5 体验最好。

en: 209 GB Xbox build leaks on launch day
Version 1.0.2.1, shipped without its executable, so it could not start.
zh: 发售当天 209 GB Xbox 版泄露
版本 1.0.2.1，缺主程序，无法启动。

en: Take-Two DMCA hits GTA 5 ports on GitHub
Mobile and web ports of GTA 5 were taken down the day before launch.
zh: Take-Two 对 GitHub 上的 GTA 5 移植发起 DMCA
发售前一天，一批 GTA 5 手机版和网页版移植被下架。

en: Digital Foundry: PS5 Pro is the best way to play
Near-locked 30 fps and a near-4K image. 60 fps is held back by the CPU.
zh: Digital Foundry：PS5 Pro 体验最好
几乎稳定 30 帧，画面接近 4K。60 帧卡在 CPU 上。

en: Fake “GTA 6 EXE” spreads the WARDEN stealer
A Google Colab link leads to a ZIP that steals passwords, Steam logins and crypto wallets.
zh: 假“GTA 6 EXE”传播 WARDEN 盗号木马
Google Colab 链接指向一个 ZIP，会盗取密码、Steam 账号和加密钱包。

en: GamesBeat: PC version targeted for Q1 2027
Four unnamed sources. Rockstar did not comment.
zh: GamesBeat：PC 版目标 2027 年 Q1
4 个匿名信源，Rockstar 未回应。

en: Development footage leaks
Cyberleek posts clips it says date from 2023. Take-Two responds with DMCA takedowns.
zh: 开发版视频泄露
大葱哥放出据称 2023 年的开发片段，Take-Two 随即发 DMCA。

en: Pre-orders open, consoles only
No PC listing on any store.
zh: 开启预购，仅限主机
任何 PC 商店都没有上架。
